In this paper, we present FlowMoDE, a flow-matching
generative model for sim-to-real monocular depth estimation
to recover fine structural details. Trained solely on synthetic
data, our model outperforms prior methods on five diverse
benchmarks. We further validate its strong ability to re-
construct fine-grained geometry in various robotic scenarios
against state-of-the-art approaches. With fewer Transformer
blocks and minimal inference steps, FlowMoDE is lighter
and more efficient than existing generative depth models.
Still, patch embedding in our flow-matching pipeline may
produce occasional flying pixels. Moreover, training only on
near-field indoor synthetic data combined with patch-wise
denoising can cause blurred edges for distant regions.

primary.evaluation_assessment: The model is evaluated against major generative and discriminative baselines on five standard real-world datasets across relative depth and point cloud reconstruction metrics [E496d30410c596036-B0018, E496d30410c596036-B0027]. Detailed ablation studies systematically evaluate decoder block combinations, feature injection techniques, and flow matching step counts [E496d30410c596036-B0031, E496d30410c596036-B0036].

primary.limitations: The authors transparently report that patch embedding can introduce flying pixels and that training solely on indoor synthetic data causes blurred boundaries in distant regions [E496d30410c596036-B0039].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is explicitly defined, detailing the conditional flow matching formulation, token modulation, single-step training loss, and two-step inference procedure [E496d30410c596036-B0013, E496d30410c596036-B0021, E496d30410c596036-B0022]. Architecture components and training hyperparameters are adequately documented [E496d30410c596036-B0014, E496d30410c596036-B0023].
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a clear and technically sound method, thoroughly validated across multiple external standard benchmarks with solid ablations and explicit discussion of failure modes and efficiency trade-offs.
primary.scoped_contribution: FlowMoDE introduces a coarse-to-fine flow-matching architecture that uses a frozen DINOv2 semantic encoder and modulated decoders for efficient, 2-step sim-to-real monocular depth estimation trained only on synthetic data [E496d30410c596036-B0002, E496d30410c596036-B0013, E496d30410c596036-B0023].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline results are measured with standard ground-truth evaluation protocols on established external benchmarks, independent of the training losses.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Ground-truth benchmark metrics on COCO, ADE20K, DIOR-R, and TinyImageNet.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Supervised training losses including focal loss, Varifocal Loss with IoU soft targets, box/mask losses, and a semantic consistency loss.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported performance metrics (e.g., 62.8 box AP and 55.3 mask AP on COCO val2017) align with the experimental evidence, and the authors explicitly caveat cross-paper comparisons regarding differing pretraining data (Objects365 vs ImageNet) and parameter counts.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The evaluation spans six diverse vision tasks across seven established benchmarks (COCO detection, instance segmentation, keypoint detection, ADE20K semantic and instance segmentation, DIOR-R oriented detection, and TinyImageNet classification) with comprehensive ablation studies breaking down individual module contributions and annealing strategies.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline performance claims are validated using standard ground-truth evaluation protocols on established external benchmarks (COCO, ADE20K, DIOR-R, TinyImageNet).
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard ground-truth benchmark metrics including COCO AP/mAP, ADE20K mIoU, DIOR-R AP50, and classification Top-1 accuracy.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Standard multi-task supervised training losses including focal loss, Varifocal Loss (IoU soft targets), box L1/GIoU loss, mask loss, and semantic consistency loss.

primary.limitations: The authors transparently note that baseline models vary in pretraining corpora (O365 vs IN-22K/IN-1K) and detector parameter counts, preventing isolated attribution of all performance margins exclusively to the backbone architecture.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed mathematically and architecturally, providing clear formulations for DINO-style saliency computation, residual gating, FiLM modulation, Laplacian filtering, layer aggregation softmax, and the three-stage cosine annealing schedule.
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a scoped architectural and training innovation with precise mathematical descriptions, reproducible implementation details, rigorous ablations, and extensive cross-task empirical validation using objective standard benchmarks.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces SAGE (Saliency-Annealed Gated Encoder), an enhanced ViT-Adapter architecture incorporating class-token saliency gating, register-token FiLM modulation, Laplacian high-frequency enhancement, dynamic multi-layer aggregation, and local crop fusion, combined with a 3-stage annealing schedule and a two-stage focal-to-VFL transition.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript presents a scoped architectural and training innovation with precise mathematical descriptions, reproducible implementation details, rigorous ablations, and extensive cross-task empirical validation using objective standard benchmarks.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors transparently note that baseline models vary in pretraining corpora (O365 vs IN-22K/IN-1K) and detector parameter counts, preventing isolated attribution of all performance margins exclusively to the backbone architecture.
